title: DevopsTestSuiteTest - Data API
description: Represents the association between a DevOps Test Suite and an individual DevOps Test, enabling tests to be organized, managed, and synchronized within a test suite. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.

DevopsTestId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
DevopsTestId.description: References the DevOps Test associated with this test suite entry.

DevopsTestSuiteId.description: References the parent DevOps Test Suite that contains this test.

IsActive.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsActive.description: Indicates whether the test is currently active within the test suite.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record indirectly, for example, through a list view or related record.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, and LastReferenceDate is not null, the user accessed this record or list view indirectly.

Name.properties: Autonumber, Defaulted on create, Filter, idLookup, Sort
Name.description: The system-generated unique identifier for the record.

SyncLogId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SyncLogId.description: References the synchronization log associated with this test suite entry.

UniqueKey.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Nillable, Sort, Update
UniqueKey.description: Stores a unique identifier used to uniquely distinguish this record within the organization.
